Dear Mr. Cho,

I enjoyed meeting you at the trade fair in Seoul last month. As we discussed, Orion Textiles would like to [1] a long-term supply agreement with your company. [2] We believe that combining your design expertise with our manufacturing capacity would [3] benefit both parties. I would be happy to visit your office [4] is convenient for you.

Best regards,
Anna Fischer

questions.explanation: One 'proposes' an agreement, meaning one suggests it.

choices: The trade fair was held at the new exhibition hall.
Your office is located on the fifth floor.
Our fabrics are already used by several leading fashion brands.
Seoul is a popular tourist destination.
questions.explanation: The sentence supports the proposal by presenting the sender's strengths.
An adverb is needed to modify the verb 'benefit'.
'Whenever is convenient for you' lets the other person choose the time.

The move to the next Saturday depends on the condition of rain.

text:

questions.explanation: 'Over the past year' requires the present perfect.

choices: The growth is the strongest the industry has seen in a decade.

questions.explanation: The sentence comments on the increase and precedes the explanation given by experts.
'Which' refers to the whole idea of working during the journey.

text:

[2] I am confident that my creative skills would be an asset to your team. I have enclosed my portfolio and résumé for your [3]. I am available for an interview [4] any time that suits you.

questions.explanation: 'Where' refers to the place (Pixel Studio) in which the work was done.

choices: I am particularly interested in your recent work for the city's tourism board.
Pixel Studio is moving to a new building in May.
Your Web site was last updated in March.
The weather in Madrid is usually mild.
questions.explanation: The sentence expresses interest in the company and leads to the claim about the applicant's skills.
A noun is needed after 'your': 'for your consideration'.
'At any time' is the fixed expression.

questions.explanation: One 'extends' a stay, meaning one makes it longer.

text:
MEMO
To: New hires
From: Training Coordinator
Subject: Orientation week

Welcome to Marlowe & Sons! Your orientation will [1] on Monday, March 10, at 8:30 a.m. in the main lobby. [2] During the first week, you will meet your team, [3] your equipment, and complete the required safety training. Please bring two forms of identification [4] your first day.

questions.explanation: After 'will', the base form is used.

choices: The cafeteria menu changes every week.
Please arrive ten minutes early to receive your visitor badge.
Annual leave requests must be approved by a manager.
The company's earnings rose last year.
questions.explanation: The sentence gives a practical instruction for the first morning.
A base form parallel to 'meet' and 'complete' is needed.
'On your first day' uses 'on' with a specific day.

I stayed at the Central Inn for three nights while attending a conference. The location is [1]: the hotel is just five minutes from the convention center. questions.explanation: An adjective is needed after the verb 'is'.
An adjective parallel to 'friendly' is needed.

text:
Dear Mr. Santos,

Thank you for submitting your claim regarding the water damage to your home. After carefully [1] the documents you provided, we have approved your claim in full. If you [4] to file a separate claim for those items, please call us at 555-0135.

questions.explanation: After a preposition ('After'), a gerund is used.

choices: We are currently hiring claims adjusters.
You do not need to take any further action at this time.
Our office will close for the holidays on December 24.

questions.explanation: The sentence follows the approval and precedes the details of payment.
After 'Please', the base form is used.
After 'If you', the base form 'wish' is used.
